  • T1 The billing prompt and citation rules are ported from the prototype as written; any wording change has Vikram's approval on record.（TFA-94229 AC 1；TFA-94229 R1；TFA-94229 R2） — gate: blocked: TFA-94229 in progress

测试设计方法：主流程（happy-path） — 照 UAT / 票的原话把正常流程走一遍，该出现的都要出现。

Given Prototype RoundCompanion_PLAYGROUND_p72_HAIKU.html, Vikram's Slack decisions (2026-09-29 to 2026-10-01) and the billing prompt files in the build under test

When Compare the billing prompt, family table and citation rules side by side

Then Every difference from the prototype is one Vikram approved on record (the 2026-10-01 'final note is the source of truth' decision included)

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：Document review by a person; list each difference with its approval or 'no approval found'
